source: Live Discord guild commands for DrewAI, checked 2026-09-18; not a remote installation check

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show available commands and how to use the bot

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the active session (session is preserved)

commands.name: compact
commands.description: Manually compact (summarize) the conversation to free context space

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Set a completion condition — Claude keeps working until it's met

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Reset the Claude Code session for this thread

commands.name: rewind
commands.description: Go back to an earlier point in the conversation

commands.name: fork
commands.description: Branch this conversation into a new thread

commands.name: tools-show
commands.description: Show current allowed tools

commands.name: tools-set
commands.description: Change allowed tools via select menu

commands.name: tools-reset
commands.description: Reset allowed tools to .env default

commands.name: sync-settings
commands.description: View or change session sync settings

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a previous session in a new thread

commands.name: resume-info
commands.description: Show the CLI command to resume this thread's session

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: List all known Claude Code sessions

commands.name: search
commands.description: Find a past thread by keyword (add body:True to grep full conversations)

commands.name: sync-sessions
commands.description: Import CLI sessions from Claude Code as Discord threads

commands.name: worktree-list
commands.description: List all active Claude Code session worktrees

commands.name: worktree-cleanup
commands.description: Remove clean orphaned session worktrees

commands.name: context
commands.description: Show the context window usage for this thread's session

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show Claude Code rate limit usage and weekly activity

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Run a Claude Code skill

commands.name: model
commands.description: Show, select, or install a model for the current backend

subcommands.name: set
subcommands.description: Select a model for the current backend

subcommands.name: install
subcommands.description: Install and select an Ollama model for the local backend

commands.name: backend
commands.description: Show or switch the AI backend

commands.name: effort
commands.description: Show or set the reasoning effort for the current backend

commands.name: engine-status
commands.description: Show/set whether the Codex usage line appears after each turn

commands.name: ollama
commands.description: Inspect and manage the local Ollama runtime

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Check the local runtime end to end

subcommands.name: list
subcommands.description: List the models installed on the server

subcommands.name: ps
subcommands.description: Show which models are loaded in memory right now

subcommands.name: show
subcommands.description: Show the details of one installed model

subcommands.name: pull
subcommands.description: Download a model onto the server

subcommands.name: rm
subcommands.description: Delete an installed model and free its disk space

subcommands.name: use
subcommands.description: Select an installed model for the local backend

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Manually trigger a package upgrade

commands.name: remind
commands.description: Set a reminder at a specific time!

commands.name: cd
commands.description: Retarget THIS thread to a folder (starts a fresh session there)

commands.name: cdnew
commands.description: Open a NEW session in a folder

commands.name: gowork
commands.description: Work through the plan, one task at a time

commands.name: stopwork
commands.description: Stop /gowork after the current task

commands.name: switch
commands.description: Switch AI and model in one step (pick from the list)

commands.name: launcher
commands.description: Open this computer's folder/session buttons
